turns.text: Today’s reading is called Landforms on Earth. What do you think it may be about? [STUDENT_TALK]
Landforms on Earth
That is the title. This reading may be about different shapes of land on Earth. [NEXT_STEP]

pages.text: One interesting landform is a valley. A valley is a low area of land. It lies between mountains. Sometimes, there may be a river that flows through the valley.

turns.text: Where does a valley lie? [STUDENT_TALK]
One interesting landform is a valley. A valley is a low area of land. It lies between mountains. Sometimes, there may be a river that flows through the valley.
Yes, a valley lies between mountains. What may flow through a valley? [STUDENT_TALK]
A river can flow through it.
Right, a river may flow through a valley. A valley is a low area between mountains. [NEXT_STEP]

pages.text: Glaciers are an important landform. However, most people will never see a glacier. Glaciers are found in colder areas. Each glacier is a huge piece of ice. It moves over the land.

turns.text: What is a glacier made of? [STUDENT_TALK]
Glaciers are an important landform. However, most people will never see a glacier. Glaciers are found in colder areas. Each glacier is a huge piece of ice. It moves over the land.
A glacier is a huge piece of ice. Where are glaciers found? [STUDENT_TALK]
In cold areas.
Yes, glaciers are found in colder areas. They are huge pieces of ice that move over the land. [NEXT_STEP]

pages.text: An island is another type of landform. An island is land surrounded by water. On some islands, there are mountains, valleys, and cliffs.

turns.text: What surrounds an island? [STUDENT_TALK]
An island is another type of landform. An island is land surrounded by water. On some islands, there are mountains, valleys, and cliffs.
Right, water surrounds an island. What is one landform that can be on an island? [STUDENT_TALK]
Mountains, valleys and cliffs.
Yes. An island can have mountains, valleys, and cliffs on it. [NEXT_STEP]

pages.text: A cave is often found in a cliff or a mountain.

turns.text: Where does the text say a cave is often found? [STUDENT_TALK]
A cave is often found in a cliff or a mountain.
Right. A cave is often found in a cliff or a mountain. [NEXT_STEP]

pages.text: Most people love islands. They especially love islands with beaches on them.

turns.text: What kind of islands do people especially love? [STUDENT_TALK]
Most people love islands. They especially love islands with beaches on them.
Yes, people especially love islands with beaches on them. [TEMPLATE_FINISH]
